name: latent-protocol-vscode
description: Earn USDC while your coding agent thinks. Shows a labeled sponsor line in the agent's spinner/status area (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex).

commands.title: Latent: Patch agent spinner (in-agent ads, advanced)

latent.enabled.description: Master on/off for the sponsored spinner.

latent.wallet.description: EVM wallet for earnings. Falls back to ~/.latent-protocol/config.json.

latent.patchAgentBundles.description: Advanced/invasive: runtime-patch the installed Claude Code / Codex extension webview bundle to render the sponsor line inside its native spinner. Reversible (pristine backup + Latent: Restore), but it modifies a third-party extension and relaxes its webview CSP to reach the local loopback. Off by default — the non-invasive status-bar + sidebar fallback is always available.

latent.rotateSeconds.description: How often the shown sponsor line rotates.

latent.cursorOverlay.description: Experimental, Cursor only: show the sponsor line in the agent composer area. Adds one script tag to Cursor's workbench.html (pristine backup kept, restored on disable/uninstall); Cursor may report its installation as modified while this is on. Re-applied after Cursor updates.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build
